deck.GetRackIdsFromDeck.description: Returns rack IDs and coordinates found in a saved deck layout file.

deck.deleteSavedDeck.description: Deletes a saved deck layout file.

deck.getPreviousDeck.description: Checks whether a previously used deck layout is available to reload.

deck.getSavedDecks.description: Returns the list of saved deck layout files.

deck.importDeck.description: Imports carriers and labware from a .lay layout file into the current deck.

deck.importRackAsSite.description: Imports a rack from a .lay layout file and registers it as a named site.

deck.loadDeck.description: Loads a saved deck layout, or reloads the previously used layout.

deck.saveDeck.description: Saves the current deck layout to a file.

labware.add1mLCoreGrip.description: Adds a 1mL CO-RE gripper tool to the deck.

labware.add5mLCoreGrip.description: Adds a 5mL CO-RE gripper tool to the deck.

labware.addCarrier.description: Adds a carrier to the deck at a specified track.

labware.addCarrierToSite.description: Adds a carrier onto a specific site, such as an existing module.

labware.addChannelLiquidWaste.description: Adds a channel liquid waste labware item to the deck.

labware.addLid.description: Adds a lid labware item to a carrier site.

labware.addLiddedPlate.description: Adds a plate with a lid to a carrier site.

labware.addLiquidWaste.description: Adds a liquid waste labware item to the deck (Vantage only).

labware.addNTR.description: Adds a stacked no-tip-rack (NTR) tip carrier to the deck.

labware.addPlate.description: Adds a plate to a carrier site.

labware.addQCG.description: Adds a QCG transport tool to the deck.

labware.addReservoir.description: Adds a reservoir to a carrier site.

labware.addSampleTubeCarrier.description: Adds a sample tube carrier to the deck at a specified track.

labware.addTipBox.description: Adds a tip box to a carrier site.

labware.addTipRack.description: Adds a tip rack to a carrier site and registers its tip pool.

labware.addTipSupport.description: Adds a tip support to a carrier site.

labware.addTransportSite.description: Registers a custom transport site with specific coordinates.

labware.addTubesToCarrier.description: Adds tubes to specific positions on a tube carrier.

labware.getLabwareParamsFromID.description: Returns the full labware definition for a given labware item on the deck.

labware.moveCarrier.description: Moves a carrier already on the deck to a different track or site.

labware.removeLabware.description: Removes a labware item from the deck.

labware.removeTransportTool.description: Removes a transport tool from the deck by tool ID.

labware.shiftLabware.description: Shifts a labware item's position by a relative X/Y/Z/angle offset.

labware.addSplitWellSite.description: Places a temporary rack of SDK-computed channel-pitch slots inside one large well so several channels can pipette into it at once.

labware.tiltLabware.description: Applies SDK-computed per-well tilt offsets (X/Y from nominal, Z as container base offset) to a plate.

status.getAddedCarriers.description: Returns the list of carriers currently added to the deck.

status.getAddedPlates.description: Returns the list of plates currently added to the deck.

status.getAddedReservoirs.description: Returns the list of reservoirs currently added to the deck.

status.getAddedTipRacks.description: Returns the list of tip racks currently added to the deck.

status.getAvailableCarrierSites.description: Returns the available (unoccupied) sites for a given carrier.

status.getAvailableTracks.description: Returns the list of unoccupied tracks on the deck.

status.getLabwareCoordinates.description: Returns the X/Y/Z/angle coordinates of a well, or the labware origin and every well's coordinates when no well is given.

status.getLabwareLocation.description: Returns the carrier/site or track location of a labware item.

status.getLabwareOnCarrier.description: Returns the labware items currently placed on a carrier.

status.getLabwarePositions.description: Returns the well positions defined for a labware item.

status.getOccupiedCarrierSites.description: Returns the sites currently occupied for a given carrier.

status.getOccupiedTracks.description: Returns the list of currently occupied tracks on the deck.

status.getTopLabware.description: Returns the topmost labware item at a carrier site, including lid info.

status.getTransportTool.description: Returns information about a transport tool matching the given criteria.

status.getTransportToolIds.description: Returns the list of transport tools and their tool IDs.

status.isTrackOccupied.description: Checks whether a specific deck track is occupied.
